statement: Ukrainian long-range strikes halt loadings at a named Russian crude export terminal - Novorossiysk, Tuapse, Primorsk, or Ust-Luga - with the strike occurring between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-21.
resolution: Reuters or Bloomberg reports suspended loadings at one of those four terminals attributed to a strike inside the window, and a Russian federal or regional official confirms the attack, by 2026-09-24.
failure_condition: No suspension of loadings at any of the four named terminals follows a strike occurring inside the window.

statement: A commercial vessel sinks or is abandoned by its crew following an attack in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-27.
resolution: UKMTO issues an incident advisory for the attack and Reuters or Lloyds List reports the vessel sank or was abandoned, both by 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Vessels attacked inside the window all remain crewed and afloat, with no sinking or crew abandonment.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above USD 100.00 per barrel on at least one trading session between 2026-08-24 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The ICE Futures Europe published daily settlement for the front-month Brent contract reaches 100.00 or higher on any session in that range, checked 2026-11-02.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement inside the window prints below 100.00.

statement: Walmart reports Walmart US comparable sales excluding fuel of 4.5 percent or higher for fiscal Q2 2027 in its scheduled 2026-08-20 earnings release.
resolution: The Q2 FY27 earnings release furnished on Form 8-K to SEC EDGAR states Walmart US comparable sales excluding fuel at or above 4.5 percent, checked 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: The reported Walmart US comparable sales figure excluding fuel lands below 4.5 percent.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog gains at least one entry naming Apple as the vendor, with a date added between 2026-08-24 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose vendorProject field is Apple and whose dateAdded value falls inside that range, checked 2026-10-19.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog holds no Apple entry with a date added inside the window.

statement: The United States publishes a formal instrument asserting sovereignty, territorial claim, or protectorate status over the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: An executive order, presidential proclamation, or Federal Register document making that assertion carries a date inside the window on federalregister.gov or the White House presidential actions page, checked 2026-11-23.
failure_condition: No executive order, proclamation, or Federal Register document asserting such a claim carries a date inside the window.

statement: FDA publishes a Federal Register document on the FSMA Section 204 food traceability rule - proposed rule, final rule, or request for information - between 2026-08-24 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: federalregister.gov lists an FDA document naming food traceability in its title or abstract with a publication date inside that range, checked 2027-01-20.
failure_condition: No FDA food traceability document carries a Federal Register publication date inside the window.

statement: A second person is charged over the 2026-08-15 Virginia State University shooting, with the charges filed between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-05.
resolution: Chesterfield County Police, the Commonwealth Attorney, or Virginia online court records show charges against a second defendant filed inside that range, checked 2026-10-08.
failure_condition: Only the single person taken into custody on 2026-08-15 stands charged at the deadline.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake within 250 km of the 2026-08-15 Flores mainshock, event us6000tkt2, with origin time between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-21.
resolution: A USGS earthquake catalog query for that radius and time range returns at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater, checked 2026-09-24.
failure_condition: The largest catalogued event inside that radius and window falls below magnitude 6.0.

statement: The Indonesian disaster agency BNPB puts the confirmed death toll from the 2026-08-15 Flores earthquake at 100 or more, in a figure issued on or before 2026-09-04.
resolution: A BNPB statement, or Reuters or AFP citing BNPB, gives a cumulative confirmed toll of at least 100 for that earthquake, checked 2026-09-08.
failure_condition: The cumulative confirmed toll stands below 100 in BNPB figures at the deadline.
